idea-plugin.name: DelveSwap
idea-plugin.description: Override the path to the Delve (dlv) debugger binary on a per-run-configuration basis for Go Build and Go Test configurations. Falls back to the global dlv.path setting when no override is set. See YouTrack GO-19800 for background.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0
  • Fixed: the GLOBAL tier now picks up edits to the IDE-wide dlv.path made after IDE startup; previously the value was snapshot once.
  • Capped plugin compatibility at GoLand 2026.2 (was unbounded), so future incompatible GoLand releases will disable the plugin rather than crashing on launch.
  • Internal refactor: renamed Registry-* types to DlvPath-* (the underlying value is a JVM system property, not an IntelliJ Registry key); package renamed to com.hoss.delveswap. Existing v0.1.0 run-config XML continues to deserialize.
1.0.0
  • Per-run-configuration Delve binary path override now works for Run on Target (SSH) debug sessions, not only local debug.
  • Writes dlv.path as a JVM system property (what the Go plugin's GoRunUtil.dlv() actually reads) instead of an IntelliJ Registry value.
  • Re-applies the override in processStarting so the two-phase build+debug execution model of remote targets doesn't lose the value between phases.
0.1.0
  • Initial release. Per-run-configuration Delve binary path override for Go Build and Go Test.
